Amendment No. S10 IS 13288 (Pari I): 1993/15014%-1: 1990

AMENDMENT 5: Door end security
Page 1, Clause 2

Addthe following Nonnative reference: ISOPAS 17712:2003, Freightcontainers - Mechanical seals

Page 3, Subclause 5.7

Addthe following to the end of 5.7: All door openings shall be fitted to accept an ISO-compliant high security seal (see ISO/PAS 17712) in a manner that precludes opening or gapping of eitherof the doorswtthout first removing the seal. The design of the container shall be such thatthe doorconstrained by the seal must be opened before the other doorcan be opened. The mechanism in which the seal is fitted shall eitherbe welded to a significant structural member of the container or otherwise be constructed so that the mechanism or seal cannot be removed and the door opened or gapped without first having to break the seal. Seal-affIxing mechanisms that do not meet these buIc requirements shall not be fllted onto the container. The door hinges shall etther be welded to the door panel or, if aff",xed w~h fasteners, affixed with TIR-approved fasteners that are further protected from removal by 8 suitable shield or equivalent design feature. Hinge pinsshall be welded in place or otherwise protected to PfWCIud8 theirremoval.
